name: ingredient-distinct
goal: 판별성 재발주 (디렉터 피드백: 계란/단무지·빵끼리 혼동) — 형태·색을 서로 확실히 다르게. 0.5초 판독성 최우선.
style: bold clean dark outlines, vibrant high-saturation colors, energetic comic cartoon sticker style, flat cel shading with one simple gloss highlight
common: single centered object, isolated on a fully transparent background, no text, no watermark, 1024x1024 PNG with alpha, generous ~12% margin, slight 3/4 top-down angle, instantly readable silhouette even at small size

items.label: 계란말이 지단
items.subject: a strip of rolled egg omelette for gimbap: PALE soft yellow with a visible rolled spiral swirl on the cut end and thin browned edge lines — clearly a rolled egg, not a plain stick

items.label: 단무지 반달
items.subject: a half-moon cross-section stick of pickled radish danmuji: VIVID neon-bright yellow, glossy translucent, flat cut face showing the half-circle shape — clearly different from egg

items.label: 크림빵
items.subject: a golden cream bun split open with a THICK wave of white whipped cream bulging out of the middle — the cream must be the most prominent feature

items.label: 소금빵
items.subject: an ELONGATED pale beige rolled salt butter bread with croissant-like ridge lines and coarse white salt flakes sprinkled on top — long shape, much lighter color than other breads
